tldr: North Node in leo: growth through visibility, creative courage, and personal warmth.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop visibility, creative courage, and personal warmth. The South Node in aquarius shows the familiar route: detachment, hiding in the group, and making distance look enlightened. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to let yourself be seen without making applause the goal.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices visibility, creative courage, and personal warmth in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in aquarius can pull the person back into detachment, hiding in the group, and making distance look enlightened.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
